== Biography ==
The index lists John Glasgow aboard Malabar, arriving at New York, New York, USA on 31 May 1849. Departure port: Greenock, Scotland. Indexed age: 76. Indexed birth: abt 1773. Other Glasgow entries share the same list image.<ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/7488/records/1023516907 New York, U.S., Arriving Passenger and Crew Lists (including Castle Garden and Ellis Island), 1820-1957: John Glasgow, 31 May 1849, record 7488/1023516907].</ref>

== Research Notes ==
This passenger index identifies the named traveller on the recorded voyage. Their wider identity is unresolved.
